data.jobspec:
#!/bin/zsh
#FLUX --account=VeloC
#FLUX --nodes=4
#FLUX --time=0:45:00
#FLUX --queue=full-node

# NOTE: The Cobalt attribute '--attr filesystems=home' is site-specific and has been omitted.
# NOTE: The Cobalt mail notification directive '-M' has been omitted, as Flux does not
# have a direct equivalent for job status email notifications.

# The original mpiexec command requested 8 tasks per node.
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=8

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# 'mpiexec' is replaced by 'flux run'. The hostfile, npernode, binding, and mapping options
# are handled automatically by Flux based on the job-level directives. The environment
# variables are exported automatically by default.
# This job requests 4 nodes and 8 tasks per node, so 32 ranks will be launched.
flux run -n 32 -o "-x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO" python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_naive_resnet18_scale --log-level info

issues: The script is a multi-node, multi-task job that likely requires GPUs, as indicated by the CUDA paths in `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` and the `NCCL_DEBUG` setting. However, no GPUs are requested in the resource directives. This is a critical omission that will cause the job to fail if scheduled on CPU-only nodes. A directive like `#FLUX --gpus-per-task=1` should be added.
The script uses zsh (`#!/bin/zsh`), which is less common than bash for job scripts and may not be available or the default shell in all HPC environments, potentially affecting portability.

The script relies on several hardcoded, user-specific absolute paths (e.g., `spack env activate /home/tbouvier/...`, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=...`). This makes the script non-portable and it will fail if run by another user or if the directory structure is changed.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/zsh
#COBALT -A VeloC
#COBALT -n 4
#COBALT -t 0:45:00
#COBALT --mode script
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT --attr filesystems=home
#COBALT -M thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
mpiexec -np 32 -npernode 8 -hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE -bind-to none -map-by slot -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x WANDB_MODE -x PATH python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_naive_resnet18_scale --log-level info
